purpose: Unified vehicle operations-intelligence history from drives, charging, alert delivery logs, software updates and user annotations; not the personal audit-action or FSM transition timelines.
primaryGoal: Understand what happened to the selected vehicle in the workspace date range, filter domains, browse newest-to-oldest events and follow real source details or export the loaded page.

dataSources.name: Activity list
dataSources.queryContract: Scope-specific key includes sorted kinds, bounds, vehicle, limit and offset; forwards cancellation signal, uses STALE_TIMES.STANDARD, validates response envelope in select.
dataSources.response: items, total, limit, offset, generated_at; snake_case event DTO fields preserved.
dataSources.sourceBehavior: UNION ALL; newest occurred_at first with source_table ASC/source_id DESC tie-breakers. Server filters before pagination; count(*) OVER() supplies total for nonempty pages. Fleet-wide annotation and applicable fleet alert rows remain eligible for vehicle-scoped reads.
dataSources.units: duration_s is seconds; energy_added_wh is watt-hours; SOC is percentage. Feed converts duration and energy only through useUnits at render time; exports retain raw source fields.
dataSources.limitations: Read source establishes composition, not working database tables, deployment, API execution or completeness. Software events use installed/scheduled/created timestamp precedence, not a separately verified lifecycle event stream. No real dated service-history source is claimed.

dataSources.name: Workspace vehicle prerequisite
dataSources.behavior: URL, persisted selection and first-known-vehicle fallback. Activity query enabled only when vehicles.length > 0. Empty or unresolved list returns NoVehicleSelected; this hook does not expose prerequisite query loading/error.
dataSources.limits: Only the page-specific vehicle selection trace was read; no vehicle repository/runtime audit.

dataSources.name: Workspace date, timezone and operational context
dataSources.endpoint: No additional page-owned endpoint inspected for these contexts
dataSources.behavior: Header-owned route, from/to URL and shared preference; no local duplicate date or vehicle controls. resolveActivityWindow caps end at asOf; if start is not before the cap, shifts start backward by max(original duration, 24 hours). Not a claim that source rows are reconstructed as they existed at asOf.
dataSources.limits: Timezone provider and lower context queries not traced; browser-versus-vehicle calendar semantics require integration resolution.

components.name: PageLayout -> PageContainer
components.role: Canonical page frame, header, overflow actions and query freshness; w-full/min-w-0 container.

components.name: ActivityOverview -> SystemSummaryBrief -> OperationalBrief
components.role: Two contextual summaries: four range/page measurements and five loaded-page kind counts; existing useOperationalMetrics formatter bridge.
components.limits: OperationalBrief and formatter internals not read; no rendered summary/drawer acceptance asserted.

components.name: KindFilterBar
components.role: Localized wrapping multi-select button group with aria-pressed; All clears selection; five domain toggles.

components.name: ActivityFeed -> TimelineItem, GlassPanel, Badge
components.role: Day-grouped source-ordered rows, source-backed detail links, localized status/severity/provenance, SI-formatted summaries.

components.name: Skeleton, QueryError, EmptyState, StaleRefreshWarning, NoVehicleSelected
components.role: Source trust, recovery, initial and prerequisite states; retain cached data on failed refresh.

components.name: ListExportMenu, Button, Text, FadeIn
components.owner: Existing forms, ui and motion categories
components.role: Loaded-page CSV/JSON, pagination, explanatory captions and reduced-motion-aware entrance.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Two existing SystemSummaryBrief instances plus an outer GlassPanel repeat description, scope and page-coverage context. This is source-confirmed repetition, not proof of excessive mounted height.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse current OperationalBrief/SystemSummaryBrief composition; review hierarchy without deleting four summary counts, five kind counts, trust labels or coverage explanations.

sourceSupported: PageLayout uses w-full/min-w-0 and vertical gap; filter and pagination groups flex-wrap.
Day panels use p-4/sm:p-6; TimelineItem has min-w-0, wrapped badges and breakable subtitles/metadata.

issues.detail: Caller does not enable TimelineItem.wrap; shared default truncates the source-authored title to one line. Narrow feeds and long annotation/alert titles risk hiding important information.
issues.fix: Use existing wrap prop for full readable titles; retain event order, summaries, provenance and links.

issues.rule: MDC-040/MDC-043; long labels and touch targets
issues.detail: Kind chips and pagination use Button size sm (h-9 / 36px); filter buttons do not opt into existing wrapLabel. At 200% text or long translations fixed heights need testing. This is below the stronger 44px mobile default, not a measured WCAG failure.
issues.fix: Use existing wrapping and minimum-target caller capabilities; validate spacing exceptions and ten widths rather than shrink or remove filters.

responsive.viewportAcceptance: Unverified at 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560, container widths, text zoom and RTL.

sourceSupported: Localized filter group and aria-pressed; decorative icons hidden in filters, feed and pagination.
Shared Button supplies focus treatment; linked rows use native router links.
Pagination uses aria-live=polite; stale warning uses role=status and aria-live=polite.
FadeIn uses existing motion preference and initial=false in reduced mode.

issues.rule: MDC-024/MDC-040; menu keyboard and focus semantics
issues.detail: role=menu/menuitem is supplied, but inspected implementation has only outside mousedown/Escape dismissal. No focus transfer, roving/arrow-key navigation or explicit focus restoration is implemented here. Runtime Tab behavior remains unverified.
issues.fix: Extend existing export owner with canonical menu/popover focus behavior or appropriate non-menu semantics, preserving localized names, exports, outside dismissal, busy/disabled states and scopes.

issues.detail: Export trigger overrides shared button height to 32px. Need measured target spacing/reachability in the real header, not a blanket WCAG claim.
issues.fix: Shared export owner should support reachable 44px mobile trigger and bounded open-menu placement without changing export behavior.

issues.detail: Source record ID is supplied only through the provenance span title attribute. CSV/JSON retains IDs, but the in-feed record detail relies on hover and lacks a keyboard/touch disclosure.
issues.fix: Retain source ID and source caption via visible detail or an existing accessible disclosure/tooltip; do not add nested interactive content to the whole-row link.

accessibility.acceptance: Keyboard, focus order/restoration, screen reader, actual contrast, forced colors, reduced motion and touch are unverified.

states.initialLoading: ActivityFeed shows six-line Skeleton; overview receives loading and unavailable measurements, not factual zeros. Initial vehicle-list resolution may instead show prerequisite UI.
states.successfulEmpty: Feed shows localized No activity in this window; filters remain usable. Successful empty envelope allows legitimate zero counts.
states.fatalError: Only state.fatalError drives feed QueryError with refetch retry; summaries remain present with unavailable measurements.
states.refreshFailure: DataState preserves cached items; StaleRefreshWarning renders beside content; overview receives retained=true on query error; pagination/export are not suppressed by raw query.isError.
states.offlineRetained: DataState handles paused refresh as stale with retained payload; warning mentions offline; PageContainer can display operational-mode badge.
states.unknownFreshness: SystemSummaryBrief honestly defaults to source observation time not supplied; generated_at/dataUpdatedAt are not conflated with event observation.
states.disabled: Export disabled during initial loading, fatal error or no loaded rows; missing direction buttons mean no corresponding page, not disabled placeholders.

issues.rule: MDC-026; unknown is not confirmed empty
issues.detail: vehicles.length===0 conflates a real empty fleet with unresolved/failed vehicle query because useSelectedVehicle returns vehicles??[] without loading/error metadata. Activity is disabled and setup guidance is returned in all cases.
issues.fix: Coordinate prerequisite trust metadata with useSelectedVehicle owner; show loading/error recovery distinctly while preserving the real no-vehicle onboarding action.

issues.rule: MDC-026; distinguish retained offline from current source
issues.detail: Overview retained flag is tied to query.isError, not state.isRefreshBlocked/status. A paused refresh with cached data can show Source available in summary while the nearby warning says offline. No false measurement is inferred, but trust labels can conflict.
issues.fix: Adapt existing DataState trust into the summary's retained/status/freshness props consistently; keep retained measurements and distinguish fetch time from source observation time.

issues.detail: Empty message states what is empty but provides no visible guidance that shared date range or kind filters can change the result; this guidance exists only in a source comment.
issues.fix: Use existing EmptyState description/help capability with localized range/kind guidance; no fake source rows, automatic filter changes or competing date picker.

states.runtime: All branches are source-inspected only, not exercised.

visualIssues.detail: Five fixed bright cyan/green/amber/indigo/purple hex accents bypass theme tokens and repeat across every timeline icon. This is saturation/rainbow noise risk, not literal neon CSS or measured fluorescence; semantic severity/status badges already communicate state.
visualIssues.fix: Subdue domain decoration through existing neutral/semantic token treatment; preserve domain icons, text labels, severity and status. Current TimelineItem supports omitting color for neutral swatch; do not mutate saved theme choices or invent a palette.

visualIssues.detail: Day headings use raw h3 text-sm/font-semibold and provenance uses raw span text-2xs instead of role typography components. Colors use text variables, so this is typography drift, not pure-white text.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing heading/caption wrappers with semantic as override, preserving headings, labels and record details.

visualIssues.detail: Shared link uses fixed white-alpha hover and cyan-400/60 focus rather than canonical control/focus tokens. This is white-overlay/focus hue drift, not proof of pure-white body text or insufficient contrast.
visualIssues.fix: Shared owner replaces hover/focus chrome with existing semantic tokens while preserving whole-row navigation, rich-slot title-only navigation and neutral fallback.

visualIssues.detail: Export dropdown retains fixed white-alpha borders/hover and shadow-xl. Review restrained elevation and light-theme interaction visibility; no actual glowing border/text found in inspected page.
visualIssues.fix: Use canonical border/control-hover/elevation tokens in existing menu owner, retaining opened content and actions.

architectureIssues.detail: Vehicle timezone is used to group/display events, but useRangeState receives no timezone. Hook defaults to browser timezone, so vehicle-local day grouping and calendar request bounds can differ.
architectureIssues.fix: Resolve workspace date-time authority with existing hook/header owners; align bounds and labels without introducing a picker or silently changing saved range policy. Add focused differing-timezone/DST evidence in implementation phase.

architectureIssues.detail: Page passes endInstantExclusive but all UNION branches filter timestamp<=end; adjacent windows can include a row exactly at the exclusive boundary. Handler documents inclusive bounds.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner must resolve actual inclusive-versus-exclusive API semantics with backend/date owners and add boundary tests. No backend changes are authorized by this audit; preserve existing behavior until explicitly reconciled.

architectureIssues.detail: total is initialized to zero and obtained only from returned rows' count(*) OVER(). Empty out-of-range offset after source changes returns total=0 even if earlier matching events exist; page total/Older calculation can be misleading.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration owner should verify empty-offset behavior and provide correct full-range count or scoped page recovery without frontend invented totals. Preserve 50-row pagination and chronological order.

priority.reason: Preservation-sensitive chronological history with timezone/boundary/count integration risks and prerequisite state conflation; otherwise already uses shared orchestration and real sources.
order: Resolve integration scope and prerequisite trust contracts.
Preserve and verify retained/offline states and all filters/actions.
Adopt existing wrapping/typography and reduce fixed saturated decoration.
Shared menu/focus token correction then mounted responsive/accessibility/visual QA.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Selected-vehicle prerequisite trust metadata
requiredSharedChanges.concreteContract: Expose or compose typed prerequisite loading, fatal error, retained data and retry from existing useVehicles without changing vehicleId/vehicle/vehicles/setVehicleId precedence or persistence. Unknown fleet must not equal confirmed zero vehicles.
dependsOn: Existing useVehicles query and selectedVehicle store; onboarding/shell owner coordination
requiredSharedChanges.scopeLimit: No other page consumers audited; reuse/expose existing query metadata rather than a second selection system.

requiredSharedChanges.name: TimelineItem semantic hover/focus chrome
requiredSharedChanges.concreteContract: Keep icon/title/subtitle/time/color/isLast/href/badges/metadata/actions/wrap API. Replace fixed-white hover/fixed-cyan focus with current control/focus tokens; retain neutral no-color swatch and both link compositions.
dependsOn: Existing CSS token contract; shared TimelineItem owner
requiredSharedChanges.scopeLimit: No new component or color prop expansion required for this page; use existing neutral color omission.

requiredSharedChanges.name: ListExportMenu keyboard/mobile/token closeout
requiredSharedChanges.concreteContract: Retain onExportCsv/onExportJson scope callbacks, visibleCount/selectedCount, disabled/className/testId and async error/busy behavior. Supply coherent menu focus/keyboard/restoration through canonical primitives; touch-safe trigger, bounded placement and semantic borders/hover/elevation.
dependsOn: Canonical overlay/menu owner, Button and control/focus tokens, existing toast feedback
requiredSharedChanges.scopeLimit: Other consumers not enumerated; cross-consumer shared acceptance belongs to owner, not this audit.

competingImplementations.name: Vehicle activity versus personal audit and FSM state timeline
competingImplementations.decision: Do not consolidate distinct sources or delete routes. /me/activity and /timeline were not independently audited.

competingImplementations.name: KindFilterBar versus single-select PillFilterBar
competingImplementations.decision: Multi-select independent domains and All reset are intentional; do not replace with single-select tabs based on cosmetic similarity. PillFilterBar implementation was not inspected.

competingImplementations.name: Operational summaries and TimelineItem
competingImplementations.decision: Already uses canonical composites; do not add a competing timeline, stats formatter, surface or summary library.

preservation.hashAlgorithm: SHA-256 of page bytes via Get-FileHash
preservation.countSemantics: Five dependency GlassPanel sites are one overview panel plus feed loading/error/empty/day branches, not five simultaneous rendered panels. Day panel count is dynamic. Counts are source baseline, not runtime parity proof.

sections.name: Header, subtitle help, query freshness and export
Range/page overview and page event-type mix

preservation.normalContentBlockDefinition: Overview, kind filters, feed, pagination, export explanation and service limitation plus conditional retained warning; header and prerequisite alternative counted separately.
actions: All clears kind selection; five independent kind toggles permit multi-select.
Shared header range/vehicle controls change scope; preserve URL/preference ownership, no second selectors.
Any vehicle/window/kind change resets offset to zero.
Newer decrements offset by 50 bounded at zero; Older increments by 50 only when matching total permits.
Fatal-source Retry and retained warning Refresh call refetch.
Detail links preserve source-provided paths; drives and charging point to IDs, alerts/software to existing list surfaces; annotations without path remain plain rows.
CSV exports only loaded items with 12 named columns; JSON exports complete raw loaded item objects.
Header subtitle help and freshness remain supplied through existing PageLayout.
Confirmed no-vehicle setup action remains governed onboarding guidance.
dataBehavior: Maintain server event chronology and tie-breakers; group by local calendar day preserving incoming across/within-day order; invalid dates use unknown bucket and dash.
Do not sort by displayed time, merge different domain identities or append fabricated service events.
Keep stable composite source IDs and raw source table/ID in exports; visible semantic provenance and record detail survive.
Keep source-authored titles and summaries; fallback localized domain titles, software version and domain lifecycle labels remain.
Keep typed SI durations, energy, SOC endpoints, severity/status and source path; absent measurements omitted, not zero.
Range total is server supplied; loaded count, active days, critical alerts and five type counts cover only this page.
Maintain response-envelope validation, cancellation, existing cache key/stale/retry policy and enablement.
Preserve asOf end cap/shift behavior without claiming historical database reconstruction or filtering source lifecycle status beyond existing queries.
Retain successful data on failed or paused refresh, distinguish fatal versus refresh failure and keep recovery reachable.
